subject.title: feat(chat): UX-012 — token usage progress meter

question: Should this PR continue as a separate 2px composer-base meter, or should the work be folded into the current context usage component?
rationale: Current main already has a freshness-aware context usage instrument, while this PR adds another visible context progress surface and needs a UX decision before repair or landing.

options.title: Rebase into the current context model
options.body: Keep the base-meter idea only if it is implemented as a presentation of the current freshness-aware context usage helper and tested for stale totals.

options.title: Fold into existing context usage
options.body: Close or narrow the branch if maintainers prefer the current compact ring/popover as the sole persistent context progress surface.

options.title: Show stale totals explicitly
options.body: If stale totals should remain visible, require an explicit updating/stale visual state and focused tests for that product policy.

recommendation.title: Rebase into the current context model
recommendation.body: Keep the base-meter idea only if it is implemented as a presentation of the current freshness-aware context usage helper and tested for stale totals.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev authored this member PR and has prior merged history in the same context/usage UI area.
